verdict.rationale: cfo.ai's only documented programmatic interface is its MCP server at api.cfo.ai/mcp. It has a documented tool reference that lets agents read and change the Model (Pages, tables, formulas, Variables) and drive Ari chats via edit_chats and inspect_chats. There is no conventional public REST API: OpenAPI/Swagger paths all 404, and the product issues no API keys or tokens, so every client must sign in as a person. missing for 10: documented REST/HTTP API with an OpenAPI spec, API keys or service tokens for headless automation, independent hands-on corroboration of programmatic use.
